explanation: Vertical stack of 5 elastic (e=1) bodies under strong gravity (30) with large dt (1/30). Gravity compresses the stack into simultaneous contacts; sequential impulse + positional correction resolves overlaps by pushing bodies apart and flipping velocities upward, injecting kinetic energy faster than gravity removes it. By step 6 energy grows from 420 J to ~505 J with zero controller work, exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Classic contact-solver energy gain in tall elastic stacks.
